paper.title_en: Wormhole geometries in extended symmetric teleparallel gravity with $f(Q, T) = αQ + βT + γT^2$
paper.abstract_en: In this study, we study static and spherically-symmetric wormhole configurations within the recently proposed class of extended symmetric teleparallel gravities characterised by the functional form $f(Q,T)=αQ+βT+γT^{2}$, where $Q$ is the non-metricity scalar, $T$ is the trace of the energy-momentum tensor, and ($α,β,γ$) are constant coupling parameters. By varying the action with respect to the metric, we derive the modified field equations and cast them in an effective Einstein-like form containing additional geometric contributions that depend on $Q$ and $T$. We conclude that the $f(Q,T)=αQ+βT+γT^{2}$ framework offers a viable arena for constructing physically realistic wormholes without invoking severe energy condition violations, opening new pathways for connecting modified gravity phenomenology with astrophysical signatures of non-trivial spacetime topologies.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究f(Q,T)=αQ+βT+γT²扩展对称远平行引力中的静态球对称虫洞解，属于修改引力中的f(Q)/远平行引力分支；摘要给出了场方程推导思路与关于能量条件的结论，理论深度与主题相关性较明确，适合点击阅读。但摘要未交代具体形状函数、能量条件分析细节与参数取值等关键信息，元数据也较简略（无DOI、无期刊信息、引用未知）。
decision.title_zh: 扩展对称远平行引力中满足 $f(Q, T) = αQ + βT + γT^2$ 的虫洞几何
decision.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们在最近提出的扩展对称远平行引力一类理论中研究静态球对称虫洞构型，该类理论由函数形式 $f(Q,T)=αQ+βT+γT^{2}$ 刻画，其中 $Q$ 是非度量性标量，$T$ 是能量-动量张量的迹，($α,β,γ$) 为常数耦合参数。通过对度规变分作用量，我们导出修改后的场方程，并将其写成类爱因斯坦的有效形式，其中含有依赖于 $Q$ 与 $T$ 的额外几何贡献。我们得出结论：$f(Q,T)=αQ+βT+γT^{2}$ 框架为构建物理上现实的虫洞提供了一个可行的场所，而无需引起严重的能量条件破坏，这为将修改引力现象学与非平凡时空拓扑的天体物理迹象联系起来开辟了新途径。
